name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each
description: Income support scheme for small and marginal farmers. Transfer directly to bank accounts.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Insurance coverage at 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops
description: Crop insurance scheme covering all stages from sowing to harvest. Covers natural calamities, pests, diseases.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh at 4% effective interest rate (with prompt repayment)
description: Provides affordable credit for cultivation needs. Covers crop production, post-harvest, and consumption needs.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
benefit: 55-75% subsidy on drip/sprinkler irrigation systems
description: Promotes micro-irrigation - drip and sprinkler systems. Goal: 'Har Khet Ko Pani' (water for every farm).

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Modified
benefit: Modified crop insurance with faster claim settlement

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing and personalized fertilizer recommendations every 2 years
description: Provides soil health cards with NPK, micronutrient levels, and customized fertilizer recommendations.

name: Karnataka Raitha Suraksha Poshana Yojane
benefit: Additional ₹4,000 per year per farmer (state top-up to PM-KISAN)

name: Karnataka SmartPDS Chip (Ration Card)
benefit: Subsidized food grains through PDS

name: Karnataka Micro Irrigation Subsidy
benefit: 50-75% subsidy on drip and sprinkler systems for Karnataka farmers

name: Karnataka Surya Raitha Scheme
benefit: 90% subsidy on solar water pumps for irrigation

name: Neem Coated Urea Scheme
benefit: Urea at subsidized MRP (₹266-276 per 45kg bag) - neem coated for slow release
description: All urea sold in India must be neem-coated to improve soil health and reduce diversion.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
benefit: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic farming certification
description: Promotes organic farming through clusters of 50+ farmers. Covers certification, inputs, and training.

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
benefit: 50-60% subsidy on horticulture crops - planting material, irrigation, infrastructure
description: Supports cultivation of fruits, vegetables, spices, flowers, and medicinal plants.

name: Agricultural Budget Calculator (KCC Top-up)
benefit: Additional KCC limit up to ₹5 lakh for allied activities (dairy, fisheries, poultry)

name: Solar Charkha and Cluster Development Program
benefit: Subsidy on solar charkha machines for rural women farmers

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
benefit: 40-50% subsidy on farm machinery - tractors, harvesters, planters
description: Provides agricultural machinery to small farmers on custom hiring basis or individual ownership.

name: National Mission on Oilseeds and Oil Palm (NMOOP)
benefit: Subsidy on oil palm planting material, drip irrigation, and intercropping

name: Karnataka Drought Mitigation Scheme
benefit: Input subsidy, cattle feed, and employment guarantee in drought-affected areas

name: Yashaswini Health Insurance for Farmers
benefit: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh for farmers and family at nominal premium of ₹150/year

name: Karnataka Mahila Krishi Yojane
benefit: Subsidy on agricultural inputs for women farmers - 50% on seeds, fertilizers, equipment

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
benefit: Support for increasing production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals through improved technology
description: Aims to increase food grain production through area expansion and productivity enhancement.

name: NFSM - Oilseeds & Pulses
benefit: Subsidy on certified seeds, micronutrients, plant protection chemicals for oilseeds/pulses

name: AgriSure - Quality Certification
benefit: Quality certification for agricultural produce - enables better market price

name: e-NAM (Electronic National Agricultural Market)
benefit: Online trading platform connecting 1000+ mandis - better price discovery
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal that unifies APMC mandis for better price discovery for farmers.

name: Karnataka APMC (Mandi) Access
benefit: Access to 156 regulated APMC mandis across Karnataka for direct selling

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Agriculture
benefit: Free skill training in modern agricultural techniques with certification

name: Karnataka TERA (Technology Enhanced Resource Access)
benefit: AI-based personalized agricultural advisory via mobile app

name: PM-KISAN Mandi Fee Waiver
benefit: Waiver of mandi fees for small farmers selling directly in APMC mandis

name: KCC for Allied Activities
benefit: KCC facility for animal husbandry, dairy, fisheries with limit up to ₹5 lakh

name: PMKSY 2.0 - Watershed Development
benefit: Watershed development, rainwater harvesting, and groundwater recharge structures

name: Karnataka Raitha Krishi Yojane
benefit: Subsidized seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides from Raitha Samparka Kendras

name: Karnataka Bhoomi Fasal Suraksha Yojane
benefit: Crop loss compensation for natural calamities up to ₹25,000/acre
